pages.text: The $(bold)Hemp Hammer$() is a crafting tool with $(bold)12 uses$() that is consumed in crafting recipes. It is used to craft $(bold)Bio Composite$() — one of the most important early-game materials.$(br)$(br)$(bold)Warning:$() The Hammer is consumed $(italic)during crafting$(). Each Bio Composite recipe uses 1 hammer durability. With 12 uses, one hammer makes 12 Bio Composites. Craft extras before you run out!$(br)$(br)The Hammer is also required to craft $(bold)Hemp Core$(), the mid-game progression gate that unlocks all machines.
